subject: partner with kognition
text:
Hi Matias,

We recently started working with LiveView Tech and Flock Safety to help
scale training data for security and surveillance vision models - similar
to Kognition's work in threat detection and site monitoring.

Many CV teams hit limits with in-house or open-source tools once real-world
data grows - managing billions of CCTV frames, ensuring temporal
consistency, and handling edge cases like PPE becomes tough. We help
automate labeling, support native video annotation, and add QA workflows to
improve data quality and model accuracy at scale.

Quick context - Encord is a data development platform for advanced CV and
multimodal AI (image, video, sensor). We are $50M Series B and have helped
200+ AI teams so far.

Are you seeing similar challenges as you expand into new deployments? Happy
to chat and compare notes.

Cheers,
Laura

--

subject: Kevin - vision pipeline
text:
Hi Kevin,

I've been following ImageVision's work in real-time analytics across
security, packaging, and industrial inspection - quite impressive range of
use cases.

Imagine you, like many of your safety/ surveillance customers, run into
issues when training data outgrows in-house or open source tools: as vision
models expand across diverse environments, keeping annotations consistent
and edge cases covered can slow iteration. We've helped CV teams from LVT,
Flock Safety, Rhombus, and Voxel tackle exactly this scaling challenge.

Quick context: Encord is a data platform for CV and multimodal AI (images,
videos, 3D), bringing curation, annotation, workflow management, QA, and
model eval into one place so teams can speed up iteration. We're $50M+
Series B and have supported 200+ AI teams.

Worth a chat?

Cheers,
Laura

text:

subject: Partnership with ImageVision
text:
Hi Venkata,

We recently started working with LiveView Tech and Flock Safety to help
scale their CV training data pipeline - similar to what you're building at
imagevision with DL models for threat detection and site monitoring.

data grows - managing billions of CCTV frames, ensuring temporal
consistency, and handling edge cases like PPE gets tough fast. Encord helps
by automating labelling, enabling native video annotation and adding QA
workflows to improve data quality and model accuracy at scale.

Quick context - we're a $50M Series B data development platform for CV and
multi-modal data (image, video, 3D) helping 200+ AI teams like Actuate,
